name: Science
description: How we learned the laws of nature and number: mathematics, physics and chemistry, from counting and Euclid to Newton, the elements, Einstein, the atom and the Higgs boson.

checkpoints.name: Counting and the first sciences
checkpoints.note: People cut tally marks on bones. Babylon and Egypt invent number systems, tables and practical geometry, and smiths learn to work copper, bronze and iron.

checkpoints.name: Greek science
checkpoints.note: Greek thinkers guess that matter is made of atoms. Pythagoras, Euclid and Archimedes prove things for the first time, and Euclid's Elements teaches geometry for two thousand years.

checkpoints.name: Zero, algebra and alchemy
checkpoints.note: Indian mathematicians treat zero as a number and write the digits we use. In Baghdad al-Khwarizmi gives algebra its name, Ibn al-Haytham studies light by experiment and alchemists invent the laboratory.

checkpoints.name: The Scientific Revolution
checkpoints.note: Copernicus moves the Earth around the Sun, Galileo tests motion by experiment, and Boyle calls for experiment in chemistry. Newton and Leibniz invent the calculus, and Newton finds the laws of motion and gravity.

checkpoints.name: Electricity and the elements
checkpoints.note: Euler and Gauss open new mathematics. Oxygen and hydrogen are found, Lavoisier and Dalton found modern chemistry, Faraday and Maxwell tame electricity, and Mendeleev draws up the periodic table.

checkpoints.name: The atom and relativity
checkpoints.note: X-rays, radioactivity and the electron are found. Marie Curie finds radium, Planck starts quantum theory, Einstein publishes relativity, and Rutherford and Bohr find the nucleus.

checkpoints.name: The quantum and nuclear age
checkpoints.note: Heisenberg and Schrödinger build quantum mechanics, and Gödel and Turing find the limits of proof and of computing. The atom is split, plastics and nylon are made, and the transistor arrives.

checkpoints.name: Particles, proofs and new materials
checkpoints.note: The laser is built, Fermat's Last Theorem and the Poincaré conjecture are proved, graphene is made and new elements fill the table. CERN finds the Higgs boson and LIGO hears gravitational waves.
